contents.name: Definition (54.16) of an exceptional curve of the first kind and the question of a contraction
Lemma 54.3.1: blowup of a regular surface at a point has exceptional curve P^1 with conormal sheaf O(1)
Lemma 54.3.4: b_*O = O and R^1b_*O = 0 for a point blowup of a regular surface
Situation 54.7.1 and the fibre-component facts for a modification of a 2-dimensional normal local ring
Lemma 54.7.3: existence of a function cutting each component of the special fibre
Lemma 54.7.4: a nonzero effective Cartier divisor supported in the special fibre has positive conormal degree on some component
Lemma 54.16.1: universal property of a contraction of an exceptional curve
Lemma 54.16.2: uniqueness of a contraction up to unique isomorphism
Lemmas 54.16.3-54.16.7: formal local ring, existence from a quasi-finite morphism, Picard sequence, twist vanishing
contents.reason: These lemmas form the proof of Castelnuovo's criterion in the existence direction, which is not one of the four items promised for this pair; they need Stein factorization and formal-functions arguments absent from the corpus.

contents.name: Lemmas 54.16.8-54.16.9: existence and projectivity of a contraction of an exceptional curve of the first kind
contents.reason: Castelnuovo's criterion in the existence direction is deliberately outside the four promised items of AG-BIR-1 and needs completion and Stein factorization machinery not available in the corpus.

contents.name: Lemmas 54.16.10-54.16.11: proper separated regular surfaces are projective (regular surfaces are quasi-projective)
contents.reason: This is a projectivity result for regular surfaces over a Noetherian base, unrelated to the contraction and factorization statements of the pair; no scaffolded item uses it.

contents.name: Lemma 54.4.1: point blowups make a zero-dimensional ideal invertible with a length drop
contents.reason: This is the Stacks route to elimination of indeterminacy through the Raynaud-Gruson domination theorem; the page instead follows the Debarre local-ring proof of factorization and does not rebuild the 54.4 machinery.

contents.name: Lemma 54.4.2: a proper modification over finitely many regular points is dominated by point blowups
contents.reason: Uses the ubiquity-of-blowups (Raynaud-Gruson) input absent from the corpus; the chosen factorization route avoids it via the local factorization lemma.

contents.name: Lemma 54.4.3: rational maps from a regular surface to a proper scheme are dominated by point blowups
contents.reason: Stacks' elimination-of-indeterminacy input for its proof of 54.17.1; the page replaces this step by the Debarre local argument, which needs only codimension-one extension of rational maps.

contents.name: Definition 54.14.1-14.2 and Lemmas 54.14.3-14.4 and Theorem 54.14.5 (Lipman) on resolution of 2-dimensional schemes
contents.reason: The general surface-resolution theorem is promised as thm-resolution-of-normal-surface-singularities but its complete proof closure needs the whole Grauert-Riemenschneider/rational-singularity development of Stacks Chapter 54 and does not fit this page.

contents.name: Lemma 54.15.1: resolution of one-dimensional Noetherian schemes by point blowups
Lemma 54.15.2: regularization of an integral curve on an ambient Noetherian scheme
Lemma 54.15.3: a point blowup drops pairwise intersection multiplicity
Lemma 54.15.4: separation of finitely many curve components by point blowups
Lemma 54.15.5: a proper closed subscheme of a regular surface becomes an effective Cartier divisor after point blowups
contents.reason: The Cartier-divisor clause is recorded on the published resolution page and is not needed in the reduced-curve form used by this pair; no scaffolded item consumes the unreduced case.

contents.name: Lemma 54.15.6: embedded strict-normal-crossings resolution on a regular surface
Lemma 54.17.1: a proper birational morphism of integral regular 2-dimensional Noetherian schemes is a sequence of point blowups
Lemma 54.17.2: two S-birational proper regular surfaces are joined by a roof of point blowups
contents.reason: A birational-map roof statement not promised by the design; the page proves only the morphism factorization and does not scaffold arbitrary birational maps.

contents.name: Lemmas 54.7.5-54.7.6 and Proposition 54.7.8 (Grauert-Riemenschneider vanishing)
contents.reason: Vanishing used only in the resolution machinery of Chapter 54; the negativity lemma 54.7.4 used on this page does not depend on it and the pair makes no vanishing claim.

contents.name: 54.16 opening definition: exceptional curve of the first kind; contractions
Lemma 54.16.1 (universal property) and Lemma 54.16.2 (uniqueness)
Lemma 54.16.8 (existence of a contraction on a proper scheme with an ample invertible sheaf)
contents.reason: Existence of the contraction (Castelnuovo criterion) is not promised by the design; the page proves only the definition, uniqueness and the blowup direction, so this lemma is not scaffolded.

contents.name: Lemma 54.17.1: proper birational morphisms between integral regular 2-dimensional Noetherian schemes are sequences of point blowups
Lemma 54.17.2: birational proper regular surfaces are joined by a roof of point blowups
contents.reason: Not among the four promised items; the page proves the factorization of a morphism, not the birational-map roof statement.
